name: Choose apps
desc: Copy needs clinical/legal review. iPhone host screen around Apple’s FamilyActivityPicker. presentAppPicker returns only a count; app identities stay as device-local tokens.

body.text: Apple’s app picker opens next. Tether never sees which apps you pick: Apple keeps that choice on this phone.

body.title: Start small
body.text: One or two apps that pull you in most is a good start. You can change this anytime.
Tether, the phone dialer and emergency calling can never be chosen or paused.

notes: Native requirement (iOS shield and app selection, Android overlay, picker and service): never shield or pause Tether, the phone dialer or emergency calling, even if they are selected or a session pauses "everything". Needs device validation.
